Collaborative mindset, thriving in fast-paced, cross-functional, dynamic, and culturally diverse environments.

Experience with some of the following AWS components (AWS ECS, AWS Lambda, AWS SNS, AWS Kinesis, AWS RDS, AWS DynamoDB)

The Journeyman Application Developer is responsible for the development, enhancement, maintenance, and modernization of enterprise applications within a Java-based technology stack. This role supports full lifecycle application delivery, including requirements analysis, secure design, development, testing, database optimization, and cloud migration efforts. Design, develop, test, and maintain enterprise applications within a Java / SQL / Kendo UI environment to support business and operational systems.

Manage and optimize databases in Oracle and PostgreSQL, including schema updates, indexing, query tuning, and performance analysis.

Experience supporting or participating in cloud migration initiatives to AWS.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Vercel Agent
jobs.description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About The Role:

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join the Vercel Agent team. Our mission is simple: deploying on Vercel should feel like adding a seasoned infrastructure engineer to your team. The Vercel Agent investigates incidents before you see them, fixes failing builds, reviews code with deep production context, and answers questions about your running app with the authority of someone who has read the logs.

Today, this work spans multiple shipped products: automated code review on every PR, AI -driven investigation of production anomalies, an intelligent support agent that resolves the majority of customer issues without human intervention, and conversational code generation . We’re now unifying these into a single agent that appears pervasively across surfaces (like the Vercel dashboard, Vercel CLI, Slack, and many more), and is capable of multi-step reasoning, code execution in sandboxed environments, and taking real actions on your behalf.

Two things we’re most excited about: self-driving infrastructure
, where 90% of what requires manual DevOps today gets handled automatically by the platform ; and framework-defined agents
, where the agent is customized to each customer’s application, injecting the right skills when they’re needed rather than dumping generic best practices.

This is a small team with an outsized mandate. You’ll work directly with leadership and across product, design , and infrastructure teams to define what self-driving infrastructure looks like — then build it.

If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday, even if the role is listed as remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

What You Will Do:

Design and build agentic systems that autonomously investigate, diagnose, and remediate production issues — from 500 errors and build failures to performance regressions and security anomalies.
Architect multi-step agent workflows that coordinate across tools, APIs, and sandboxed code execution environments, with durable state that survives crashes and timeouts.
Build the skills and tool integrations that give the agent deep knowledge of the Vercel platform, such as deployments, functions, logs, metrics, DNS, and the full lifecycle of a web application.
Ship polished, user-facing experiences across multiple surfaces (Slack, dashboard, CLI) without waiting for a designer to hand you a mockup. This team values engineers with strong product and UI instincts.
Develop the infrastructure for dynamic skill injection, so the agent acquires new capabilities at runtime rather than through redeployment, routing the right logic to the right context at the right time.
Collaborate with other engineers on prompt engineering, model evaluation, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines that ground the agent in accurate, up-to-date knowledge.

About You:

7+ years of full-time software engineering experience, with strong TypeScript proficiency. Engineers with deep Python experience who are excited to work in TypeScript are also a great fit.
A track record of openness and adaptability: you’ve shifted into new technologies, new domains, or new roles and thrived. This space is changing faster than anyone can claim expertise; we want people who learn and adapt, not people who play expert.
Strong product and UI sensibility. You care about the details of how an AI interaction feels to a user, and you can build great experiences without waiting for a designer.
Full-stack capability with an understanding of infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, and how large-scale web applications operate.
Experience building or contributing to frameworks, platforms, or reusable abstractions, not just feature work. You know when to build a primitive versus ship a one-off.
Demonstrated ability to ship independently, influence architecture, and set direction on a small, high-impact team.
Excellent communication skills, with an ability to translate technical detail into actionable insight for both engineering and partner teams.

Bonus if you:

Have experience building agentic systems, AI tooling, or automation frameworks, and especially agents in production. You understand the difference between a demo and a system that works reliably at scale.
Are familiar with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.), prompt engineering, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
Have worked with Vercel, Next.js, or the modern web deployment ecosystem.
Have experience with sandboxed execution environments, container orchestration, or secure multi-tenant systems.

Compensation & Benefits:

Competitive compensation package, including equity.
Inclusive Healthcare Package.
Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
Flexible Time Off.
We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $232,000 - $348,000 (Staff level IC and above). Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, level/experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

Note:
Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. Therefore, in order to be considered for this position, you must have the ability to work in the United States without a need for current or future visa sponsorship.

Must be located near or within the Raleigh-Durham area.

Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking a hands-on Software Engineer IV to drive end-to-end solution delivery for major retail platforms.

In this role, you will own hands-on implementation (feature development, technical design, code reviews), engagement leadership (client-facing technical lead, trade-off decisions, mentoring), and operational ownership (delivery sign-off, post-release support) of high-impact solutions, translating business requirements into working software you help build. You will drive Dual-Track Agile processes, contributing to the Discovery Track through rapid prototyping and feasibility validation, and leading the Delivery Track to ensure quality, traceability, and measurable outcomes.

The ideal candidate is a senior software engineer who codes daily, prototypes proactively, and integrates AI/agent workflows across the software lifecycle—from analysis and design to testing, documentation, and code generation—while bringing the technical leadership to drive client engagements forward. You will mentor teams, make critical technical trade-offs, and take full accountability for delivery sign-off and post-release support.

This role requires strong retail platform domain knowledge (POS systems, store operations), cloud-native development experience, and fluency with generative and agentic AI tools to accelerate delivery while preserving code quality and architectural integrity. You will be a key driver of engineering excellence, ensuring solutions are both innovative and operationally robust.

Key Responsibilities

Instrument and leverage AI/agentic workflows in your daily development to accelerate design, prototyping, code generation, test-case creation, specification drafting, and automated validation across the software lifecycle.
Apply AI-assisted development practices in your own work, model best practices for the team, and ensure ethical compliance and responsible integration of generative AI tools.
Own end-to-end solution delivery across Discovery and Delivery Tracks, personally building validated prototypes, contributing to formal designs, decomposing work into deliverables, and shipping accepted technical implementations.
Drive the Discovery Track under Dual-Track Agile by writing working prototypes and demoing solutions to validate feasibility and align stakeholders before full implementation.
Translate discovery outcomes into delivery backlog items and partner with implementation teams to ensure design intent, code quality standards, and non-functional requirements are preserved throughout delivery.
Contribute to technical design across products and integrations: produce ADRs, interface contracts, data models, sequencing diagrams, migration/rollback plans, and traceability matrices, partnering with architects on broader governance.

You’ll work on distributed systems and Kubernetes-based infrastructure, helping simplify how services are developed, deployed, and operated across cloud and on-premises environments. We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

As an early member of the Bridge engineering team, you'll have the autonomy to work on projects that are truly global in scale and aim to give customers access to products they've never had access to. Many of the use cases that we work on today didn't exist several months ago, and that's because our team is dedicated to constant improvement for our partners and end users. Our engineers have outsized ownership over projects, so if you're looking for increased autonomy working on a completely greenfield opportunity, Bridge is the place for you.

Experience with building API products a plus, but not required
Experience working with blockchain or distributed systems a big plus

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

About The HR Product Team

The HR Product Engineering team is the foundational layer of Rippling's unified workforce management system. Our mission is to build seamless, global, and compliant systems that power the entire employee lifecycle, from hire to retire.

We operate at the critical intersection of HR, compliance, and enterprise software. Our products manage the most sensitive and essential aspects of a company's relationship with its people, requiring us to solve complex problems related to scale, data security, and multi-product integration.

What We Build

HRIS (Human Resources Information System): Building the core employee record, organizational structure, and workflows that serve as the single source of truth for all other Rippling products.
Time: Developing accurate, scalable, and globally compliant Time & Attendance systems, including clocking, time-off accrual, and scheduling, ensuring employees are paid correctly and legally.
Benefits: Creating and maintaining the marketplace and administration tools for health, retirement, and other employee benefits, handling complex enrollment, eligibility, and provider integrations.
Talent: Designing products that manage employee growth, performance, and learning, helping companies develop and retain their workforce effectively.

Design and implement features with an emphasis on backend logic, API development, and data integrity, while also contributing to the frontend implementation.
Work across the stack, focusing on API design, event modeling, and robust data management while ensuring a seamless connection to the user interface.
Own the full development lifecycle for features, ensuring that the backend architecture supports both reliable functionality and excellent frontend performance.
Work closely with cross-functional partners to understand requirements, refine technical scope, and drive successful, reliable feature delivery.

Prioritize projects based on business impact, ensuring high-quality implementation without unnecessary complexity.

Excellent skills in communicating technical trade-offs across the stack with clarity and precision to both frontend and backend partners.

Title: Frontend Developer with Payments & Foreign Exchange
Location: Tampa, FL - Onsite
Primary Skill: FX (Foreign exchange), Payments, TypeScript, .JS

Job Requirements
We are seeking a Principal / Lead Front-End Developer with 12+ years of experience to lead the front-end architecture, user experience, and web development for enterprise Payments and Foreign Exchange (FX) platforms.
In this role, you will design and build responsive, high-performance, and secure web applications used for multi-currency payment processing, FX trading dashboards, real-time transaction monitoring, and payment analytics tools.
You will establish front-end architecture standards, build reusable design systems, and collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, Backend Java/AWS Developers, and QA Leads.
Lead the design, technical strategy, and implementation of modular, scalable, and responsive front-end architectures using modern frameworks (React.js, Angular, or Vue.js).
Architect multi-currency dashboards, real-time rate tickers, cross-border payment initiation screens, SWIFT/ISO message status monitors, and complex transaction flow interfaces.
Optimize web applications for low latency, high rendering speed, and real-time updates (using WebSockets, Server-Sent Events, and RxJS) under high data throughput.
Manage complex application state and integrate interactive charts, financial widgets, and high-performance data grids (e.g., AG-Grid) for tracking FX trade volumes and payment flows. Implement secure web development practices to safeguard sensitive financial data, preventing OWASP vulnerabilities (XSS, CSRF), ensuring secure token management (OAuth2/OIDC), and aligning with banking security controls.
Establish UI/UX design systems, reusable component libraries, code quality guidelines, automated testing strategies, and mentor front-end engineering team members. Partner with Product Owners, UI/UX Designers, Java/AWS Microservices Engineers, and QA Teams to ensure seamless API integration and intuitive user journeys.
12+ years of core web development experience using JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, and advanced front-end frameworks (React.js, Angular, or Vue.js).
Domain experience building front-end interfaces for Foreign Exchange (FX) platforms, cross-border payment processing, multi-currency accounting, or corporate banking portals.
Deep proficiency with state management architecture (Redux Toolkit, NgRx, Zustand) and real-time streaming tools (WebSockets, RxJS, SSE) for live market data and transaction tracking.
Work Experience 10+ Years

Applications accepted until further notice.

As part of this role, you will be responsible for maintaining services in a FedRAMP compliant environment, therefore, must be a U.S. citizen. This position may also perform work that the U.S. government has specified can only be performed by a U.S. citizen on U.S. soil.

Meet the Team

Splunk's Control Plane organization builds the foundational, self-service automated platform that empowers hundreds of internal engineering teams to deploy world-class cloud services with speed and safety. By abstracting infrastructure complexity and delivering friction-free deployment workflows, our team directly accelerates how fast Splunk delivers mission-critical observability and security innovations to global enterprises. We are a collaborative, inclusive, and high-impact engineering group that operates with curiosity, autonomy, and mutual mentorship across multi-cloud environments. What makes our team exciting is the opportunity to work on an immense scale, solve deep distributed systems challenges, and leverage artificial intelligence to automate large-scale production infrastructure.

Your Impact

In this role, you will contribute directly to a large-scale codebase deploying daily across multiple cloud platforms—including AWS, GCP, Azure, and GovCloud—to serve thousands of enterprise customers. You will architect self-service developer tools and abstractions that enable internal engineering teams to safely manage infrastructure without central bottlenecks. You will deploy and monitor production systems across multi-cloud environments, tuning telemetry, metrics, and alerting to drive operational excellence. You will participate in supported on-call rotations to diagnose complex system anomalies, resolve production incidents, and identify root causes. Additionally, you will build and integrate AI-powered tools into engineering workflows to automate configuration changes and optimize continuous delivery pipelines.

Minimum Qualifications

Meet one of the following (completed within the past 3 years or expected to be completed within the next 12 months):
A Master's degree with 0 years of work experience; or
A Bachelor's degree with 2 years of work experience; or
An educational or workforce development program (e.g., Associate’s, Apprenticeship, Boot camp, or Certification) with 3 years of work experience; or
A High school diploma (or equivalent) with 4 years of work experience.
Qualifying education and work experience should be in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline.
Demonstrated proficiency writing software, data structures, and algorithms in at least one modern programming language (such as Go, Python, or Ruby).
Hands-on experience building, deploying, or managing cloud infrastructure across major cloud providers (Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, or Microsoft Azure).
Applied coursework or practical experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Configuration as Code (CaC), or automation tooling (such as Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, or CloudFormation).

Preferred Qualifications

Practical experience with Docker containers and Kubernetes container orchestration, including command-line tooling (kubectl).
Working knowledge of distributed systems concepts, including concurrency control, consistency models, CAP theorem, or distributed databases/file systems.
Familiarity with CI/CD deployment pipelines, automated testing, system observability/telemetry, and Unix/Linux terminal environments.
Experience leveraging generative AI tools or machine learning models to automate developer tooling, infrastructure workflows, or script execution.
Demonstrated ability to take proactive ownership of engineering deliverables, communicate technical concepts effectively, and thrive in an agile team environment.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Take catastrophe simulation, digital twins and AI from research code to reliable production at a venture-backed insurtech.

A well-funded, venture-backed insurtech is hiring an Applied Science Platform Engineer for the team behind its physics simulations, digital twins and AI/ML models. This company doesn’t price risk by zip code. It simulates how real catastrophes affect individual properties, then automates underwriting and mitigation before loss occurs. As it expands into new geographies and perils, such as hurricane, the platform underneath has to scale with it.

Reporting to the Applied Science Platform Lead, you’ll own pipelines end to end: design, build, deploy, monitor and fix. The work spans simulation pipelines, CI/CD, GPU training and inference infrastructure and geospatial data processing, on multi-cloud infrastructure managed as code, Kubernetes and HPC batch compute. You’ll work closely with Physics Simulation Engineers, ML Engineers and peril-specific SMEs, turning their needs into platform capabilities and shipping tooling they use daily.

You’re the right person if you’ve run long-running, resource-heavy workflows on compute orchestration or schedulers (Prefect, Airflow, Dagster, SLURM, Kubernetes) that move tens of GBs or more per run, and you know how they fail: queueing, preemption, partial reruns. You have 3+ years building production-grade data, simulation or modeling pipelines with real automation, monitoring and alerting, and a strong software engineering foundation with tested, maintainable code. You’ve owned DevOps for the systems you run, including cloud infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code, containerization, CI/CD, observability and incident response, and you can trace a downstream symptom back to its root cause in data, code or infrastructure. You communicate clearly and briefly, and have a strong bias toward action in a fast-moving environment.

Strong plus: startup or zero-to-one experience, ML infrastructure (GPU training and inference, evaluation frameworks, model monitoring), production support for physics-based workflows like CFD or multiphysics, and geospatial or Earth-observation data experience.

Compensation: $195-225k base + equity + benefits. Reach out to discuss specifics.

Think you’re a fit? Apply now.

The Automation Engineer will be responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining automation systems to support custom manufacturing equipment and special processes. This includes PLC programming, industrial robotics and cobots, data acquisition systems, and custom software development using languages such as Python, JavaScript, and C++. This is a critical role within the engineering team and requires strong technical problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Develop, implement, and maintain PLC programs to support custom equipment.
Assist Manufacturing Engineering and CNC Applications in the implementation of industrial robotics and/or cobots for process automation.
Develop and maintain central data acquisition systems for special processes, such as furnaces, pump systems, chemical processing lines and other industrial applications.
Create, debug and implement custom automation using Python, JavaScript, C++, etc. for internal processes.
Support Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, and other departments with automation solutions and technical expertise as needed.
Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering, CNC Applications, and other technical teams to ensure successful implementation of automation projects.

Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Controls Engineering, or related field
PLC programming experience (Allen-Bradley, Siemens, or similar preferred)
Experience with industrial robotics and/or collaborative robots (cobots)
Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, C++, or similar programming languages
Experience with data acquisition systems and industrial networking preferred
Experience with PID controls methodology is preferred.
Pyrometry experience preferred but not required
Strong verbal and written communication
Demonstrated ability to solve highly technical problems

What We Offer

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)
Additional 40 hours of Sick Time
Paid Parental Leave
Competitive 401(k) plan with employer matching contributions
Education reimbursement program for professional development
Climate-controlled facility
Subsidized vending and on-site break areas
Complimentary coffee and refreshments
Clean, modern work environment with advanced equipment and technology
Opportunities for career growth within a stable, growing aerospace manufacturing organization

Physical Requirements

Ability to stand and walk for extended periods throughout the work shift.
Ability to frequently use hands and fingers to operate machine controls, tools, and measuring instruments.
Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull materials and components weighing up to 40 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.
Ability to bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, and reach as required to load, unload, and inspect parts and equipment.
Ability to perform repetitive motions involving the hands, wrists, and arms.
Ability to visually inspect parts, interpret and read blueprints, technical drawings, work instructions, and use gauges, and measuring devices.
Ability to distinguish colors, dimensions, and surface defects when performing quality inspections.
Ability to hear and communicate effectively in a manufacturing environment.
Ability to safely operate equipment in a fast-paced production setting while wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE), including safety glasses, hearing protection, safety shoes, and other equipment as required.
Ability to work in an environment with exposure to machine noise, metal chips, cutting fluids, lubricants, and varying temperatures.
Ability to maintain regular attendance and work scheduled shifts, including overtime as required.

Work Environment

Manufacturing environment with exposure to moving mechanical equipment.
Frequent interaction with machine tools, raw materials, and finished products.
Compliance with all company safety policies, housekeeping requirements, and Foreign Object Debris (FOD) prevention practices.
Required use of appropriate PPE and adherence to all safety procedures.

Essential Functions Disclaimer

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

About Heico

Heico has a history of success. Since its founding over 40 years ago The Heico Companies has grown from a single business to over 80 separate companies through a strategic acquisition policy, and by reinvesting its earnings into internal growth and new prospects. Historically talented at restoring distressed companies, Heico now strategically targets acquisitions that will complement its ever-growing portfolio of companies in manufacturing, construction, and industrial services.

These four core operations are organized into groups: Metal Processing Group, Construction Solutions Group, Applied Solutions Group, and Industrial Technologies Group. Once acquired, new Heico companies are assigned to a group and run on a stand-alone basis, allowing for great independence as well as the opportunity to share knowledge about markets, production processes, and management practices across other Heico groups and companies. Each Group has its own corporate team.

Heico continues to seek out new opportunities and maintain its standard of success. The Heico Companies has remained a privately held company since its creation and maintains a majority ownership in each of its operations, which generates more than $3.3 billion dollars in revenues. Many of our businesses are certified Woman-owned Business Enterprises (WBE).

More information about the holding company and overall organization can be found at www.heicocompanies.com.

jobs.title: Sr. Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Description

Whisker is redefining what it means to live with cats—designing intelligent systems that remove friction, elevate the everyday, and celebrate the quiet brilliance of feline companionship. Today, Litter-Robot leads the category. Tomorrow, an entire ecosystem that expands what’s possible for cats and the people who love them. We believe the future is feline. And we’re imagining that future today.

We work onsite 4+ days a week, with our team based in Auburn Hills, Michigan, and Juneau, Wisconsin. Our team of 700+ passionate pet people thrives on collaboration, innovation, and the occasional office cameo from a four-legged friend.

What You’ll Do
:

The Senior Automation Engineer helps the QE team build and run the automation platform that tests Whisker's robots, firmware, backend services and mobile app. They maintain the shared framework and CI pipelines, bring new features and products under automated test faster, and build the lab rigs, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) setups and tools that make system-level testing possible. They step in on API, firmware and app testing as the team needs, and keep automated results fast, reliable and trusted.

Requirements and Qualifications:

This list of duties and responsibilities is not all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities as deemed necessary.

Maintains and extends the shared automation framework and its CI/CD pipelines across firmware, backend services and the mobile app
Brings new features and products under automated test quickly, working with engineers and QE to decide what to automate and how
Designs and builds lab test rigs, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) setups and simulation environments that make system-level testing possible
Builds internal tools and libraries that speed up test authoring, execution and reporting for QE and engineering teams
Keeps the lab reliable: device management, automated flashing and provisioning, test agents and CI runners, and recovery from device faults without manual intervention
Builds end-to-end tests that span device, cloud and mobile app, including long-duration soak and stability runs
Develops and maintains automated tests at the API, firmware and mobile app layers, and supports test execution where the team needs it
Triages automated failures, separates product defects from test defects, and reduces flaky tests so results can be trusted
Partners with firmware, backend and app engineers on testability and early test planning
Reports test health and coverage so teams can see release readiness
Uses AI tools to write, refactor and review test code, generate test scenarios and analyze failures, and brings new AI-enabled practices to the team
Documents automation interfaces and test harnesses
Mentors QE engineers and shares automation practices across the team
Will perform additional responsibilities when required

Requirements

What You’ll Bring
:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field, and / or equivalent years of experience.
5+ years of experience in test automation or an SDET role, building and maintaining automated test frameworks.
Programming and scripting experience for test automation, such as Python or TypeScript.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines (for example GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners), containers (Docker) and source control (Git).
Experience with API test automation.
Hands-on experience with hardware or embedded test benches, lab equipment (for example multimeters and oscilloscopes), or HIL setups.
Experience testing connected or IoT products across device, cloud and mobile app.
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
Hands-on experience using AI tools (such as AI coding assistants) in daily work to write, refactor and review test code, generate test scenarios, and analyze failures and defects.
Experience with test management and defect tracking tools (for example Jira).
Familiarity with agile development methodologies.
Able to explain complex technical topics to technical and non-technical partners.
Maintains confidentiality of proprietary information.
Able to build and maintain cooperative working relationships with team members and colleagues.
Comfortable with office pets (cats, dogs).

Not Required but Nice to Have!

Experience testing firmware or embedded systems, including debugging with tools such as JTAG or logic analyzers, and OTA updates.
Experience with mobile test automation (iOS and Android).
Experience with AWS services such as CloudWatch, API Gateway, Kinesis, Cognito or VPC.
Familiarity with device communication interfaces (UART, SPI, I2C) and wireless protocols.
Experience building or maintaining device simulators or virtual robots for testing.

Benefits & Perks:

Join a tenacious, inventive company that empowers team members to chart their own path, lead by grounding decisions in the “why”, and has a strong sense of empathy and openness to new perspectives. Be a part of exciting growth, work with incredible people, and create tomorrow’s pet products—plus a whole lot of extras. You will also be provided with:

Premium Medical/Dental/Vision insurance
Paid parental leave

1 day "pawternity" leave for new pet adoption
Pet Insurance Discount

Top of the line equipment

Whisker products and swag

Meet the Team

Join Splunk’s Frameworks & Runtime Services team, where we’re building the next generation of internal developer platforms that power Splunk Cloud. Our team focuses on making it easier for engineering teams to build, deploy, and manage services across multi-tenant Kubernetes environments, spanning public clouds and on-premises infrastructure.

As Splunk continues to modernize its platform and expand Kubernetes-based deployments, our work plays a critical role in improving developer productivity, simplifying service onboarding, and accelerating the delivery of new capabilities to customers. Our tooling and frameworks have already helped enable the deployment of many services on cloud reducing manual effort and operational complexity.

We’re a collaborative team that values technical ownership, knowledge sharing, and practical problem-solving. You’ll have the opportunity to work on high-impact engineering challenges, influence platform architecture, and build solutions adopted by teams across Splunk. If you enjoy creating tools and platforms that make other engineers more productive, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Impact

As a Software Engineering Technical Leader, you’ll design and develop the foundational tools, frameworks, and services that enable Splunk engineering teams to build and deploy applications efficiently at scale. You’ll work on distributed systems and Kubernetes-based infrastructure, helping simplify how services are developed, deployed, and operated across cloud and on-premises environments. Your contributions will directly influence developer productivity, platform reliability, and the speed at which Splunk delivers new capabilities.

Design and build scalable developer platforms: Develop backend services, APIs, tools, and frameworks using Go and Python to simplify service development, onboarding, and deployment across multi-tenant Kubernetes environments.
Advance cloud-native infrastructure: Build and enhance platform capabilities that support workloads across AWS, GCP, Azure, and on-premises environments, improving deployment automation, consistency, and scalability.
Improve developer productivity: Collaborate with engineering teams to identify common development and deployment challenges, create reusable solutions, and reduce the time and effort required to bring new services into production.
Drive technical excellence and reliability: Contribute to architecture discussions, technical design documents, code reviews, testing, and production troubleshooting. Participate in a scheduled, compensated on-call rotation to support platform reliability and continuous improvement.
Collaborate and influence engineering practices: Partner with cross-functional engineering teams, contribute to technical roadmaps, mentor fellow engineers, and explore AI-assisted development tools and automation to improve engineering workflows and productivity.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years, Master’s with 6+ years, or PhD with 3+ years of related experience.
4+ years of experience developing production services or infrastructure tooling using Go (Golang) or Python.
Experience mentoring engineering members and leading technical initiatives to support team growth
Experience deploying, configuring, or troubleshooting containerized applications using Kubernetes on a public cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Experience developing or maintaining distributed systems, internal developer platforms, or shared infrastructure tooling used by multiple teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience and ability to break down ambiguous requirements, build a vision for the platform, and execute that vision.
Experience leading the end-to-end design and delivery of large-scale platform projects that improved developer productivity or system scalability.
Experience developing backend applications, automation, or infrastructure tooling using Python.
Experience building reusable developer frameworks, self-service tooling, CI/CD pipelines, or infrastructure automation to improve developer productivity and service onboarding.
Experience with networking concepts, service-to-service communication, databases, or storage technologies in distributed and cloud-native environments.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools or automation to support software development, testing, troubleshooting, or other stages of the software development lifecycle.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

The work:

Accenture Federal Services is seeking a Quality Assurance Tester to join our team and support our client in Washington, DC. As a Quality Assurance Tester, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliability and performance of software applications through both automated and manual testing methods. Your day-to-day activities will involve designing and executing test cases, identifying defects, and collaborating closely with development teams to resolve issues efficiently. You will leverage your expertise in .Net, Python, bash, PowerShell and/or JavaScript/TypeScript to create robust automation scripts, while also applying your knowledge of front-end frameworks to validate user interfaces and workflows. Your attention to detail will be crucial as you verify that all software components meet stringent quality standards before deployment. In this role, you will benefit from hands-on experience with a variety of testing tools and processes, such as automated testing frameworks, bug tracking systems, and continuous integration pipelines. Exposure to front-end technologies and scripting languages will enhance your ability to identify and troubleshoot issues across different layers of the application.

What you’ll do:

Design, develop, and execute automated and manual test cases for web applications
Collaborate with development teams to ensure quality throughout the software development lifecycle
Identify, document, and track software defects using established processes
Test front-end frameworks for functionality, usability, and compatibility
Analyze test results and provide actionable feedback to developers
Participate in test planning, estimation, and status meetings
Maintain and update test documentation as needed

Here's what you need:

2 years of experience in quality assurance/testing (manual & automated)
Experience with Atlassian tools such as: JIRA or Confluence
Experience with Selenium and Cypress
Experience running queries to validate data
Experience with Gitlab/Git for source control of code
Active Top Secret clearance required

Bonus points if you have:

Bachelor's degree in a technical field and 1 year of experience working within AWS cloud infrastructure
Experience in .Net
Experience in JavaScript/TypeScript
Previous experience with automated testing tools & frameworks
Prior experience in a secure environment

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Why This Role Exists

A2Z Sync runs the deal for dealership rooftops across the United States: digital retail, desking, F&I, and in-store operations on one platform. Every one of those transactions, and every integration with the DMS, CRM, and lender systems around it, produces data. Today that data runs on AWS, from dealer system integrations through an Athena semantic layer to the reports our teams and partners rely on every day.

Now we are building A2Z 2.0, an AI-driven data and intelligence platform for dealers, on a new lakehouse. The agents and insights it delivers are only as good as the data underneath them: fresh, modeled, governed, and fast. That is the Data Engineer's job. You will architect, build, and operate the analytical data ecosystem that feeds reporting today and the intelligence platform tomorrow, with the reliability that a showroom floor demands.

This is a builder's role on a small team. You will own pipelines end to end, from ingestion to the models analysts and agents query, and you will be in the room when the platform's data decisions get made.

Scope & Scale

Thousands of dealer tenants on the platform, each with isolated databases and per-tenant configuration
Data pipelines spanning 6 integration domains with multi-protocol vendor connectivity (REST, SOAP, event-driven)
An Athena semantic layer of 40+ views feeding Power BI reports and the A2Z Insights self-serve app, used by Product, Ops, Engineering, IT, Finance, and strategic partners
A new dealer lakehouse (bronze, silver, gold on Iceberg) coming online for A2Z 2.0, with Beta this fall and general availability early next year
Production AI agents whose tools and context depend on the data you serve

What You'll Own

Data workloads on AWS. Architect, build, and operationalize pipelines and storage using Glue, Athena, S3, DynamoDB, Lambda, Step Functions, and, where the workload calls for it, Timestream, Flink, and Kafka
The lakehouse. Bronze, silver, and gold layers on Iceberg: table design, partitioning, compaction, and the storage-format decisions (Parquet, Iceberg, ORC) that keep queries fast as data grows
Data models and access. Models that analysts, reports, and agents can trust; secure data access APIs in Java and/or Python; real-time streaming where the use case earns it
Pipeline reliability. Monitoring, alerting, logging, and freshness and completeness checks, so breaks are caught before the Data and BI Analyst or a dealer sees them
Anomaly detection and data quality. Statistical and ML-based monitoring of data quality and integration call volumes, so a spike, drop, or silent failure surfaces early
Forecasting and predictive features. Model development in Python (scikit-learn, pandas, numpy) for forecasting and predictive analytics that feed A2Z 2.0 insights
Governance and security. SSL/TLS, client authentication, access auditing, and the controls that keep dealer data inside its tenant
Cross-functional delivery. Working with engineers, product managers, and the Data and BI Analyst to turn data requirements into scalable, secure, high-quality solutions

First 90 Days / First Year

First 90 Days:
Learn the platform, the integration domains, and the semantic layer well enough to trace any reported number to its source. Take ownership of the pipelines feeding reporting and add freshness and completeness checks where they are missing. Ship your first production change to the lakehouse. Publish a point of view on the ingestion and modeling patterns A2Z 2.0 should standardize on.

First Year:
The A2Z 2.0 lakehouse is in production with bronze, silver, and gold layers you built or hardened, serving reports and agents at GA. Pipeline incidents are caught by your monitoring before users report them. At least one forecasting or anomaly-detection model is live and used in the product or in operations. The patterns you set are the ones the next data engineer inherits.

Hands-On Expectations

Roughly 70% building and operating (pipelines, models, APIs, monitoring), 20% design and architecture with the platform and AI teams, and 10% working with analysts and product on requirements and enablement. You write and ship code every week.

Tech & Tools

Data platform: Amazon Athena (Presto/Trino SQL), AWS Glue, S3, Apache Iceberg lakehouse (bronze, silver, gold), DynamoDB, Lambda, Step Functions
Streaming and time series: Timestream, Flink, Kafka (where the workload calls for it)
Languages and ML: Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn), Java, SQL
Reliability and governance: CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, freshness and completeness checks, SSL/TLS, access auditing
Downstream: Power BI, Amazon Quick (under evaluation), A2Z Insights, AgentCore-based agents

How You'll Use AI

This is not a "we are AI-curious" company. We use Claude every day, and we expect you to as well. Concrete examples for this role:

Draft and test pipeline code, SQL, and data-quality checks with Claude, then verify against known-good numbers before anything ships
Generate lineage and documentation from the models themselves so the map from source to report to agent stays current
Summarize pipeline incidents into root-cause notes and runbook entries the on-call engineer can act on
Build the data foundations the A2Z 2.0 agents stand on: the tables, APIs, and context they query, held to the standard that the same question returns the same number
Prototype forecasting and anomaly-detection approaches faster, so you spend your time on evaluating them against dealer outcomes

You will not be replaced by AI. You will be the Data Engineer who builds the data the AI runs on.

Role Specifics

Department: Engineering
Location: Denver, CO, hybrid (2 days/week in office) or Remote (US, outside the Denver market)
Employment Type: Full-Time

Requirements

Must Have

Extensive experience architecting, building, and operationalizing data workloads on AWS (Athena, Glue, S3, DynamoDB; Timestream, Flink, or Kafka a plus)
Deep understanding of high-performance analytical data platforms, distributed systems, and modern data file formats (Parquet, Iceberg, ORC)
Expertise building services and APIs on top of data platforms in Java and/or Python
Strong background in data modeling, data access API design, and production monitoring and alerting
Python for analytics and ML (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn), including anomaly detection with statistical or ML methods
Clear writing: pipeline documentation, data definitions, and incident summaries that engineers and business users both understand
Problem-solving, collaboration, and continuous improvement in a fast-paced, small-team environment

Strongly Preferred

Lakehouse experience with Iceberg (or Delta/Hudi) and medallion-style layering
Real-time streaming in production (Flink, Kafka, Kinesis)
Experience serving data to LLM agents or AI features: tool-facing APIs, retrieval, feature stores
Multi-tenant SaaS data architecture: tenant isolation, row-level security, per-tenant configuration

Nice to Have

Automotive retail, fintech, or dealer-tech experience, including DMS or CRM data
Power BI or Amazon Quick semantic modeling, or dbt-style transformation workflows
Infrastructure as code (CDK or CloudFormation) and CI/CD for data pipelines

Benefits

We pride ourselves on cultivating a fun, casual, and collaborative workplace culture where your hard work is recognized, your contributions drive real results, and your impact is felt every day. At A2Z Sync, we're deeply committed to our employees' well-being, starting with comprehensive benefits designed to help you care for yourself and your family.

jobs.description:
Pulse Biosciences (Nasdaq: PLSE): Join the Future of Bioelectric Medicine

Pulse Biosciences is a novel bioelectric medicine company committed to health innovation that has the potential to improve the quality of life for patients. The Company’s proprietary CellFX® nsPFA™ (nanosecond Pulsed Field Ablation) technology delivers nanosecond pulses of electrical energy to non-thermally ablate cells while sparing adjacent noncellular tissue.

The Company is actively pursuing the development of its CellFX nsPFA technology for use in the surgical treatment of atrial fibrillation and percutaneously in a select few other markets where it could have a profound positive impact on healthcare for both patients and providers. Visit pulsebiosciences.com to learn more.

Why Join Us?

At Pulse Biosciences, we are driven by purpose and innovation.
Our Mission: To build a viable Company that designs, produces, and commercializes nano-pulse technology to improve and extend the lives of patients. To solve the needs of patients, physicians, and healthcare providers with high quality and high reliability products and services, developed in accordance with rigorous scientific, engineering, and clinical standards. We exist to make a positive difference in the lives of patients, physicians, healthcare providers, shareholders and our Pulse Biosciences team members.
Our Culture: A community of creative, forward-thinking individuals tackling challenges with ingenuity and collaboration.
Our Commitment: Hiring the best and brightest minds to advance our world-class organization.

What You Will Experience

Culture and Purpose - Purposeful and rewarding work collaborating with bright and curious minds brings us together!
Innovative Environment - An environment that fosters innovation to take products from concept to human use quickly!
Growth Opportunities - Learning culture focusing on professional and personal growth and development that you can only get in a startup-like environment!
Comprehensive Benefits - A variety of health insurance plans and supplemental insurance options, and 401k retirement savings plan.
Ownership and Rewards - Stock options awards and Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) to share in our success.
Work-Life Balance - Enjoy paid time off, paid holidays, flexible work schedule and wellness program, including onsite gym and mindfulness classes.
Diversity & Inclusion - A commitment to providing a respectful work environment to our diverse workforce.

About The Role

The Sr. Software Test Automation Engineer will be responsible to design, develop, and maintain software test automation frameworks and automated tests for medical device software and system subsystems to improve test coverage, repeatability, efficiency, and reliability, including automation of appropriate manual test procedures and integration with continuous integration and continuous testing infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software development, software test methodologies, Python-based test automation, and embedded or real-time systems operating on QNX, Linux, or similar operating systems. This role will work closely with software, systems, quality, and other engineering functions to establish robust automated testing throughout the software development lifecycle, support verification and validation activities, and resolve software and system issues necessary to deliver safe, effective, high-quality, and reliable products.

To Make An Impact, You Will

Determine the appropriate scope of software test automation; contribute to test strategies, plans, designs, and automation architecture; and evaluate and select appropriate tools, frameworks, and methods for automated testing.
Develop, configure, and maintain automation frameworks, test environments, fixtures, simulators, utilities, and scripts that support reusable test components, consistent execution, automated result collection, and clear reporting of test outcomes.
Work with software developers to establish and reuse automated unit and integration tests, test stubs, drivers, mocks, simulators, and other test assets, and integrate automated testing into continuous integration and continuous testing workflows.
Execute automated and manual testing, analyze results, document defects and objective evidence, and investigate failures using appropriate logging, data capture, and diagnostic capabilities to differentiate device failures from test environment, automation framework, interface, or equipment failures.
Collaborate with software, systems, electrical, quality, and other engineering disciplines to understand requirements, interfaces, intended behavior, and testability, and continuously improve unit, integration, subsystem, system, regression, and verification test processes.
Develop and execute software testing in an FDA-regulated medical device environment and support software and system verification and validation activities, including automated verification methods where appropriate.
Perform functional, interface, negative, boundary, fault-condition, regression, and risk-based testing to demonstrate that software meets defined requirements and specifications, including appropriate coverage of risk controls and safety-related requirements and maintenance of bidirectional traceability between requirements, tests, results, defects, and applicable risk controls.
Support software engineering tools and infrastructure associated with test automation, continuous integration, automated builds, regression testing, test reporting, and software deployment.
Participate in cross-functional product definition, requirements review, integration, verification, and validation activities, with particular emphasis on requirement clarity, verifiability, testability, interfaces, acceptance criteria, and complex software and system behavior.
Investigate and identify root causes of complex software, test automation, interface, and system issues using appropriate debugging and analysis tools, and clearly communicate technical issues, results, risks, and recommended actions to engineering and project leadership.
Perform code reviews, contribute to coding standards and software engineering practices for automated test infrastructure, and mentor engineers in test automation, debugging techniques, and effective use of the test framework.
Demonstrate a collaborative, adaptable, and results-oriented approach while complying with the company's Quality Policy, Quality Management System, and applicable company policies and procedures.

To Excel, You Will Bring

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
5+ years of relevant software development, software test, or test automation experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience developing software test automation for embedded, real-time, medical device, or other complex systems in a regulated product-development environment is strongly preferred.
Experience developing test frameworks, automated tests, and scripting applications for embedded software, subsystem interfaces, and hardware/software integrated systems using Python and Shell/Bash on Linux, BSD, QNX, or similar operating systems using x86 and ARM processor platforms.
Experience with software engineering concepts and the software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, implementation, testing, and support.
Familiarity with version control, test management, and issue-tracking tools (e.g., Git, Bitbucket, Jira).
Demonstrated commitment to developing robust, reliable, and maintainable products and test systems.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, critical-thinking, and communication skills, including experience writing technical documentation.
Working knowledge of good software engineering development practices, including software development in an FDA-regulated environment.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively, exercise good judgement and initiative, manage multiple priorities, and adapt to changing requirements with minimal direction.
Ability to lift 10-15 pounds.

Pay Range

Compensation is determined based on a wide range of factors including location, job-related skills, experience, education, and training. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role. This pay range is specific to Northern California location. Base salary range: $130k - $160k. This position is located onsite in Hayward, CA and candidates must reside in the San Francisco Bay Area. No relocation offered.

Ready to Shape the Future of Healthcare?

Apply today to join Pulse Biosciences and help us redefine the boundaries of medicine with bioelectric innovation. To learn more about us, visit our website at www.pulsebiosciences.com.

We provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all persons regardless of race, age, color, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, religion, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Meet the Team

Join Splunk’s Frameworks & Runtime Services team, where we’re building the next generation of internal developer platforms that power Splunk Cloud. Our team focuses on making it easier for engineering teams to build, deploy, and manage services across multi-tenant Kubernetes environments, spanning public clouds and on-premises infrastructure.

As Splunk continues to modernize its platform and expand Kubernetes-based deployments, our work plays a critical role in improving developer productivity, simplifying service onboarding, and accelerating the delivery of new capabilities to customers. Our tooling and frameworks have already helped enable the deployment of many services on cloud reducing manual effort and operational complexity.

We’re a collaborative team that values technical ownership, knowledge sharing, and practical problem-solving. You’ll have the opportunity to work on high-impact engineering challenges, influence platform architecture, and build solutions adopted by teams across Splunk. If you enjoy creating tools and platforms that make other engineers more productive, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Impact

As a Software Engineering Technical Leader, you’ll design and develop the foundational tools, frameworks, and services that enable Splunk engineering teams to build and deploy applications efficiently at scale. You’ll work on distributed systems and Kubernetes-based infrastructure, helping simplify how services are developed, deployed, and operated across cloud and on-premises environments. Your contributions will directly influence developer productivity, platform reliability, and the speed at which Splunk delivers new capabilities.

Design and build scalable developer platforms: Develop backend services, APIs, tools, and frameworks using Go and Python to simplify service development, onboarding, and deployment across multi-tenant Kubernetes environments.
Advance cloud-native infrastructure: Build and enhance platform capabilities that support workloads across AWS, GCP, Azure, and on-premises environments, improving deployment automation, consistency, and scalability.
Improve developer productivity: Collaborate with engineering teams to identify common development and deployment challenges, create reusable solutions, and reduce the time and effort required to bring new services into production.
Drive technical excellence and reliability: Contribute to architecture discussions, technical design documents, code reviews, testing, and production troubleshooting. Participate in a scheduled, compensated on-call rotation to support platform reliability and continuous improvement.
Collaborate and influence engineering practices: Partner with cross-functional engineering teams, contribute to technical roadmaps, mentor fellow engineers, and explore AI-assisted development tools and automation to improve engineering workflows and productivity.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years, Master’s with 6+ years, or PhD with 3+ years of related experience.
4+ years of experience developing production services or infrastructure tooling using Go (Golang) or Python.
Experience mentoring engineering members and leading technical initiatives to support team growth
Experience deploying, configuring, or troubleshooting containerized applications using Kubernetes on a public cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Experience developing or maintaining distributed systems, internal developer platforms, or shared infrastructure tooling used by multiple teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience and ability to break down ambiguous requirements, build a vision for the platform, and execute that vision.
Experience leading the end-to-end design and delivery of large-scale platform projects that improved developer productivity or system scalability.
Experience developing backend applications, automation, or infrastructure tooling using Python.
Experience building reusable developer frameworks, self-service tooling, CI/CD pipelines, or infrastructure automation to improve developer productivity and service onboarding.
Experience with networking concepts, service-to-service communication, databases, or storage technologies in distributed and cloud-native environments.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools or automation to support software development, testing, troubleshooting, or other stages of the software development lifecycle.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Job Description

Please note that this is a hybrid role requiring 3 days in the office.

Great software starts with people who are curious enough to question how things work and bold enough to build something better. At Sage, you won’t spend your internship watching from the sidelines. You’ll contribute to real engineering work from day one.

At Sage, we create technology that helps businesses work more effectively and make better decisions. With colleagues and customers around the world, you’ll see how ideas become products and services with real impact.

Why join Sage?

This is not an internship built around observation or hypothetical exercises. You’ll join a live engineering team and work on technology connected to Sage, our products or our customers.

You’ll learn from experienced engineers, use modern development practices and see how software is designed, tested and delivered in a global technology business. You’ll have support from your manager, technical mentor and buddy, alongside structured learning and an intern community.

Key Responsibilities

We’re looking for curious, motivated people who enjoy solving problems and want to turn ideas into working technology. You’ll contribute to team priorities while building your confidence as an engineer.

You will:

Design, develop and test software with support from experienced engineers
Break problems into manageable steps and compare different technical approaches
Write clear, maintainable code and respond constructively to review feedback
Use source control, testing and other engineering tools as part of day-to-day delivery
Investigate defects and use evidence to identify likely causes
Consider security, privacy, reliability, accessibility and performance when building solutions
Use approved AI tools thoughtfully, checking outputs with your own technical judgement
Share progress clearly and collaborate with engineers, product managers and other interns

Your Real-World Engineering Project

A key part of the internship will be a defined engineering project with a clear problem, audience and outcome. Depending on your team, this could involve building or improving software, exploring an AI-supported solution, working with data, testing AI outputs or developing a proof of concept.

Agree the scope and success measures
Explore different approaches before deciding what to build
Design, develop and test your solution
Use AI and engineering tools responsibly
Gather feedback through regular check-ins and a midpoint review
Present a working demonstration and explain your decisions
Reflect on what worked, what you would change and what you learned

What we are looking for

People who thrive here are curious, practical and willing to keep learning. We care more about your potential and thinking than the number of technologies you already know.

You may be studying Computer Science, Software Engineering or another relevant technical subject.

You will bring:

An interest in building technology and understanding how it works
Fundamentals in at least one programming language
A structured approach to solving problems
The confidence to ask questions and try different approaches
Clear communication and the ability to explain your thinking
A collaborative approach and willingness to contribute to a team
Learning agility and openness to feedback
An interest in how AI is changing software development, balanced with human judgement

You do not need professional software engineering experience. University work, personal projects, hackathons, societies, work experience and experimenting with technology all count.

What you will gain

Hands-on experience with real engineering work
A completed project you can explain and demonstrate
Structured technical learning and regular feedback
Support from a manager, technical mentor and buddy
Experience of modern engineering practices and responsible AI use
Exposure to Sage leaders and colleagues across the business
A cohort of interns learning alongside you
Potential consideration for an approved 2028 graduate role, subject to performance, business need and eligibility

What you can expect from the process

Apply online with your resume
Complete the online assessments.
If successful, attend an assessment center or local selection event
Successful candidates will join our Summer 2027 internship program

Here at Sage, we are committed to inclusivity for all. If there are any adjustments that would help you thrive in the application process or during your internship, please contact earlycareersadjustments@sage.com For all other queries, please contact earlycareers@sage.com

Together with our customers, we aim to safeguard our nation, sustain human presence in space, and secure the freedom of operations in low Earth orbit and beyond.

Our success is measured by the trust of those who rely on what we build and deliver, and our technologies keep the United States and its allies mission-ready throughout space.

We are mission-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team.

About The Role

Launch Your Future at Sierra Space!

Begin your career journey alongside the industry's most brilliant and innovative minds. At Sierra Space, interns engage with meaningful projects while developing the foundation for an exceptional career in aerospace and defense. Our early career professionals benefit from a distinctive experience—receiving dedicated mentorship while collaborating directly with recognized industry experts on real-world challenges aligned with their academic focus. Bring your knowledge and passion for learning, and we'll provide transformative experience.

Summer Intern Academy: May 24, 2027 - August 13, 2027.

The Sierra Space Summer Intern Academy runs for 12 weeks during the summer of 2027 for undergrad students graduating between December 2027 and June 2029. Participants work on meaningful projects, network with industry experts, and develop skills at one of our state-of-the-art facilities.

This opportunity is in-office and in-person five days a week.

In this role, you will help our team to design, build, and test software for spacecraft systems and mission tools. You will collaborate with development teams to write and debug code, participate in code reviews, and support projects involving artificial intelligence. You will gain hands-on experience with modern programming languages and the full software development lifecycle.

About You

Our mission is driven by an unyielding commitment to advancing space-based technology in service of our customers and safeguarding national security. We seek individuals who are passionate about innovating beyond boundaries and relentlessly pursuing solutions that protect, preserve and empower – to join us in this critical mission.

We’re looking for team members who align with our values, mission and goals – while also meeting the minimum qualifications below. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

This opportunity can be based at any of the following locations:

Louisville, CO
Broomfield, CO
Centennial, CO
Madison, WI
Durham, NC

During your internship, you will
:

Master essential business processes and procedures.
Strengthen your technical expertise through hands-on application and expert guidance.
Participate in our comprehensive program developed by our University Talent Acquisition team.
Engage in cross-functional workshops and leadership sessions that provide valuable insights into our operations and Sierra Space's forward-thinking culture.
Join us in our mission to build the next generation of space innovation and become part of the team that's expanding humanity's reach beyond Earth.

Actively enrolled in an undergraduate degree program
Expected graduation date between December 2027 - June 2029
Passion for solving problems by leveraging data and technology
Excellent written and verbal communication

Working at the Naval Nuclear Laboratory we foster pride in belonging to an organization whose culture is made up of these core values: Trust, Empowerment, and Collaboration. Our company promotes a positive culture while ensuring the safety and reliability of our nation's naval nuclear reactors, and training the Sailors who operate those reactors in the U.S. Navy's submarines and aircraft carrier Fleets. Looking for a lifetime career? Apply today!

Job Description

The Naval Nuclear Laboratory (NNL ) Information Technology (IT) Department is looking for a Software Developer to support the custom and low code application development. The Entry-Level Software Developer supports the design, development, testing, and maintenance of business applications using both low-code platforms and traditional programming languages. This role assists with building workflows, forms, dashboards, integrations, and custom application features based on user and business requirements. The developer collaborates with senior developers and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues, document solutions, and follow established coding, security, and quality standards. The ideal candidate is eager to learn new technologies, applies sound problem-solving skills, and contributes effectively in a collaborative development environment.

Required Combination Of Knowledge And Skill

Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in a related field; or
Master's degree from an accredited college or university in a related field.

Preferred Skills

Familiarity with software development fundamentals, including variables, data structures, debugging, testing, and version control.
Exposure to low-code/no-code development platforms (e.g., Microsoft Power Platform, ServiceNow) or a willingness to learn them.
Basic understanding of web technologies, including HTML, CSS, REST APIs, JSON, and client-server architecture.
Understanding of secure coding practices, access controls, data handling, and software quality principles.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document solutions and work with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
Willingness to learn new platforms, tools, development standards, and business processes in a structured team environment.
