new_jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Please note that this is a hybrid role requiring 3 days in the office.

Great software starts with people who are curious enough to question how things work and bold enough to build something better. At Sage, you won’t spend your internship watching from the sidelines. You’ll contribute to real engineering work from day one.

At Sage, we create technology that helps businesses work more effectively and make better decisions. With colleagues and customers around the world, you’ll see how ideas become products and services with real impact.

Why join Sage?

This is not an internship built around observation or hypothetical exercises. You’ll join a live engineering team and work on technology connected to Sage, our products or our customers.

You’ll learn from experienced engineers, use modern development practices and see how software is designed, tested and delivered in a global technology business. You’ll have support from your manager, technical mentor and buddy, alongside structured learning and an intern community.

Key Responsibilities

We’re looking for curious, motivated people who enjoy solving problems and want to turn ideas into working technology. You’ll contribute to team priorities while building your confidence as an engineer.

You will:

Design, develop and test software with support from experienced engineers
Break problems into manageable steps and compare different technical approaches
Write clear, maintainable code and respond constructively to review feedback
Use source control, testing and other engineering tools as part of day-to-day delivery
Investigate defects and use evidence to identify likely causes
Consider security, privacy, reliability, accessibility and performance when building solutions
Use approved AI tools thoughtfully, checking outputs with your own technical judgement
Share progress clearly and collaborate with engineers, product managers and other interns

Your Real-World Engineering Project

A key part of the internship will be a defined engineering project with a clear problem, audience and outcome. Depending on your team, this could involve building or improving software, exploring an AI-supported solution, working with data, testing AI outputs or developing a proof of concept.

Agree the scope and success measures
Explore different approaches before deciding what to build
Design, develop and test your solution
Use AI and engineering tools responsibly
Gather feedback through regular check-ins and a midpoint review
Present a working demonstration and explain your decisions
Reflect on what worked, what you would change and what you learned

What we are looking for

People who thrive here are curious, practical and willing to keep learning. We care more about your potential and thinking than the number of technologies you already know.

You may be studying Computer Science, Software Engineering or another relevant technical subject.

You will bring:

An interest in building technology and understanding how it works
Fundamentals in at least one programming language
A structured approach to solving problems
The confidence to ask questions and try different approaches
Clear communication and the ability to explain your thinking
A collaborative approach and willingness to contribute to a team
Learning agility and openness to feedback
An interest in how AI is changing software development, balanced with human judgement

You do not need professional software engineering experience. University work, personal projects, hackathons, societies, work experience and experimenting with technology all count.

What you will gain

Hands-on experience with real engineering work
A completed project you can explain and demonstrate
Structured technical learning and regular feedback
Support from a manager, technical mentor and buddy
Experience of modern engineering practices and responsible AI use
Exposure to Sage leaders and colleagues across the business
A cohort of interns learning alongside you
Potential consideration for an approved 2028 graduate role, subject to performance, business need and eligibility

What you can expect from the process

Apply online with your resume
Complete the online assessments.
If successful, attend an assessment center or local selection event
Successful candidates will join our Summer 2027 internship program

Here at Sage, we are committed to inclusivity for all. If there are any adjustments that would help you thrive in the application process or during your internship, please contact earlycareersadjustments@sage.com For all other queries, please contact earlycareers@sage.com

new_jobs.title: Engineering Applications Software Engineer Level 1
new_jobs.description:
Job Details

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

Responsibilities

The qualified candidate will be a member of the Advanced Information Analysis and Visualization Group (341C) in JPL's Artificial Intelligence and Data Science section, reporting to the Group Supervisor, and will provide software engineering and operational support to NASA/JPL Flight and R&D project customers.

Designs, develops, and/or modifies engineering applications for highly complex or specialized capabilities within spacecraft, instrument/sensor, telecommunications, control systems, electronic ground support equipment (egse), navigation, planning, or similar data and mission software systems. Utilizes extensive domain-specific engineering expertise to understand the needs of the customer, translate needs into requirements, develop prototype applications, iterate with customers and then deliver quality applications. Involved in entire life-cycle of system, including planning, development, deployment and maintenance. Responsible for understanding and meeting software operational and engineering requirements.

Tasks include but are not limited to:

Provide software development, operational and customer support for flight mission and R&D project customers using on premise and cloud-hosted data management systems.
Meet with project task leads to design, develop, maintain and operate data management, GenAI and data visualization software systems.
Support high-performance flight computer hardware integration with commercial GPUs
Develop new or port existing algorithms and software onto high-performance flight computer systems
Knowledge of electrical integration to support flight hardware and testbeds
Design and develop 3D and 2D data visualization and dashboard software as well as UI/UX interfaces to support mission ground systems and Digital Twin development.
Design, develop and deploy web and cloud-centric software applications for the entire flight mission life-cycle, from formulation through launch and operations.
Be responsible for the design and development of AWS GenAI pipelines used for analysis and visualization of very large flight mission telemetry data sets.
Develop and deliver hardware and software documentation, such as requirements and design documents, and operational procedures.
Ensure compliance with applicable Laboratory policies and procedures, NASA policies and procedures, and government regulations.

Qualifications

Typically requires a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Math or related discipline with a minimum of 1 year of related experience or Master’s degree with 0 years of experience.
Willing to complete NASA's required Level of Confidence background check for physical and logical access to critical NASA assets.
Knowledge of modern software development tools and practices (GitHub, Visual Studio Code, continuous integration, automated software testing, Agile methodology, etc.).
Excellent applied math skills including Linear Algebra.
Excellent software engineering skills and algorithm development, with strong system debugging and problem-solving skills.
Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills.
Full stack web and legacy language application development experience.
Demonstrated experience developing GenAI pipelines on-premise and AWS-hosted using Parquet, Athena, Claude, Bedrock.
Proven decision-making and problem-solving skills in a complex and dynamic work environment, including the ability to perform highly complex analysis and assessments.
Proficiency in C, C++, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, WebGL, React, MaterialUI, Angular.
Experience designing and developing user-facing web and desktop UI/UX software.
Knowledge of modern Information Data Management tools, architectures and best practices, including modern relational and time-series database solutions.
Knowledge and experience with modern data science/data analytics tools and techniques, including GenAI/ML/LLM.
Strong commitment to customer satisfaction with effective broad-based teamwork skills.
Proven ability to establish task priorities and manage change as flight project data management needs evolve over time.
Proven ability to resolve highly complex and/or technical mission control system issues.
Practical knowledge and use of DevOps practices and tools, including continuous integration and containerization.

JPL has a catalog of benefits and perks that span from the traditional to the unique. This includes a variety of health, dental, vision, wellbeing, and retirement plans, paid time off, learning, rideshare, childcare, flexible schedule, parental leave and many more. Our focus is on work-life balance, and living healthy, fulfilling lives as we Dare Mighty Things Together. new_jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern
new_jobs.description:
About Mytra

We’re creating an entirely new way to solve the most ubiquitous problem in industry - moving and storing material. We’re applying robotics and distributed software to create a new class of product for this $1T market. We’re focused on the supply chain industry first. The industry is in a massive bind with the continued growth of e-commerce, sharp rise in costs, and supply chain disruptions. What has been a “sleepy” industry for decades is now at the epicenter of sustaining the global economy.

About The Role

The orchestration team builds the backend software that manages all of the work that needs to happen in a Mytra system: what every bot should work on, when, how, and in what sequence, in addition to tracking the current state of the system and all of the work requests.

This internship owns one piece of that: the integration layer between Mytra and a customer's system.

Every Mytra deployment has to exchange work with whatever the customer already runs. You will build, own and test the middleware layer that makes those touch points work

What You’ll Do

Build the middleware that sits between Mytra's system and a customer's, translating the work they send us, and the state we send back.
Map a customer’s worksite’s workflow onto Mytra’s, and find the places where the two don’t line up.
Design robust solutions to all touch points: what happens on a message we don't understand, a missed message, a request that arrives twice, or a system that goes quiet mid-exchange?
Build the test coverage that proves the integration works without needing a live customer system on the other end.

Ideal Candidates

Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.
Comfortable in at least one backend language (Go, Python, Java, C++ or similar) and willing to work in Go.
You have built something that talks to something else: an API, a service, a protocol, an app. Coursework and personal projects count!
You are adept at using AI tools to work more efficiently, but are aware of where those tools have shortcomings. You validate their output rather than trusting it inherently.
You are not afraid to ask questions early and often.
You can own a scoped piece of work without daily pair programming.
You care whether your code is correct, and you write the tests that would catch you being wrong.

Nice To Have

Experience with relational databases, particularly SQL or Postgres.
Message pub/sub technologies like NATS, Kafka, MQTT, or similar.
Any experience making two systems talk that were not designed for each other.
Exposure to warehouse, logistics or supply chain software.
An interest in algorithms, scheduling or optimization problems.
Prior internship, research, lab or competition experience.

A Final Note

If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t check every box. At Mytra, we build bots, but we hire humans. We value thoughtful challengers who communicate with clarity and respect, and we’re lifelong learners committed to getting better every day. We move fast, learn faster, and show up for each other under pressure. The best outcomes come from diverse perspectives working together to build something meaningful and built to last

Benefits Include

Competitive compensation and equity grants at a high-growth company backed by top-tier VCs
Fully subsidized health coverage, including medical (baseline plans), dental, and vision for employees and dependents
401(k) plans and employer-subsidized life insurance
Fully subsidized lunch and snacks at HQ—we eat and share stories together at the “long” table
Generous PTO and company-paid holidays, including one week over the winter break so everyone can recharge together
Voluntary pet insurance, Voluntary Life Insurance, Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity
Fully subsidized tax advisory services and education to help you understand your equity
Commuter benefits, including a up to $150 monthly commuter benefit
Lively, modern combined office and lab space where we rapidly iterate through design, build, and test phases
Fully equipped onsite gym and showers at headquarters

Pay Notice

Compensation for this position will be set based on the candidate's experience level and location. The posted salary band is applicable only to the San Francisco Bay Area and is subject to change.

This role requires on-site presence at our Brisbane, CA headquarters, for close collaboration with the other teams.

The Software Engineer will support and enhance the software and automated test systems used to manufacture, test, verify, and commission FDA-regulated medical devices. The engineer will diagnose production and test failures, perform root-cause analysis, create diagnostic tools, and maintain validated test systems within a regulated manufacturing environment.

Responsibilities

Develop, maintain, and improve software and automated test systems used in the manufacturing, testing, verification, and commissioning of FDA-regulated medical devices.
Design, implement, and troubleshoot LabVIEW, NI TestStand, and Python-based test solutions that interface with industrial PCs, sensors, data acquisition hardware, and automated equipment.
Diagnose production and test failures in a regulated manufacturing environment and determine appropriate corrective actions.
Perform detailed root-cause analysis of issues affecting test systems, software, and hardware integration.
Create, refine, and maintain diagnostic tools to support ongoing production and test activities.
Support validated test systems, ensuring they remain compliant with regulatory and quality requirements.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve technical issues related to automated test equipment and software.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of test processes, automation frameworks, and system reliability.

Essential Skills

Proficiency in Python for test development and automation scripting.
Experience with hardware troubleshooting in a production or test environment.
Hands-on experience with NI TestStand or a similar automated test framework.
Experience with LabVIEW for developing and maintaining automated test systems.
Knowledge of software validation practices, particularly in regulated or medical device environments.
Proficiency with Git or similar version control systems for managing source code and test scripts.
Experience with C++ and high-level software development for test or automation systems.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
Experience working with FDA-regulated or medical device manufacturing environments.

Job Description

The College of Arts & Sciences has an outstanding opportunity for an Application Developer to join their team.

About This Opportunity

Reporting to the Lead Software Engineer, the Application Developer is responsible for building, testing, and maintaining web applications that support academic, research, and administrative workflows across one of the University's largest and most diverse colleges.

This role works across the full application stack, including backend APIs, relational databases, data integrations, and accessible user interfaces. The position contributes to a modern Python-based application environment using frameworks such as FastAPI and works alongside senior engineers, infrastructure staff, and stakeholders to deliver sustainable, secure, and reliable services.

This is a team-based position that provides opportunities for cross-training and skill development across related functional areas. The role includes supporting other engineers as needed and serving as backup to ensure reliable and continuous service delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Build, test, and maintain features across the full stack of the team's web applications using Python and modern frameworks such as FastAPI. (15%)
Work with senior engineers and stakeholders to translate business and technical requirements into application features that follow the team's established architecture and standards. (10%)
Implement backend services, APIs, and data integrations that support application workflows. (10%)
Build accessible, responsive user interfaces that connect to the team's APIs. (10%)
Maintain and enhance existing applications, including their integrations with University systems and external APIs. (10%)
Write unit and integration tests, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines supporting automated testing, builds, and deployments. (10%)
Diagnose and resolve application issues and defects, bringing complex problems that span application code, data, and system integrations to senior engineers. (10%)
Apply secure coding practices and address application performance and reliability issues. (5%)
Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and shared standards. (5%)
Produce and maintain technical documentation for applications, APIs, and development workflows. (5%)

Three (3) or more years of professional experience in software development, including full stack or backend-focused roles.

Additional Qualifications

Experience building web applications and APIs.

Demonstrated ability to work both independently and in a collaborative team environment while meeting deadlines.
Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to work with clients and colleagues with varying levels of technical background.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and creative problem-solving ability.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with modern Python web frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
Experience with a front-end framework such as Angular.
Experience working with relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL or MySQL.
Familiarity with containerization and deployment concepts such as Docker or Kubernetes.
Experience working in higher education or similarly complex institutional environments.

Working Conditions

Work is performed in an office environment using standard computing equipment.
Occasional evening work is required to apply security updates.
This position may need to respond to service-impacting issues and coordinate with other technical teams to maintain reliable service delivery.

This recruitment requires a cover letter. Applications that do not include a cover letter will not be forwarded to the hiring department.

CAS IT provides technical and organizational leadership for application development, infrastructure platforms, systems integration, and technology services across the College of Arts & Sciences. The platform processes transaction events and delivers notifications through email, SMS, and API channels. Engineers on the team develop and maintain distributed, event-driven services that support critical fraud prevention, security, and customer engagement products.

Tools and workflows for onboarding new accounts and funds
Ongoing improvements as we support more accounts, funds, and data sources

Evaluating distributed data-processing approaches for computationally intensive workloads
Simplifying existing calculation pipelines as we integrate additional external data sources
Improving the reliability, observability, and maintainability of performance systems

Improving data quality and reliability
Supporting new B2B integrations and use cases as they grow

Business Intelligence & Metrics

Maintaining and improving BI dashboards and reporting

Ensuring the underlying data is accurate, reliable, and easy to understand
Improving the overall self-service analytics experience across the company

3+ years experience in software engineering with a primary focus on the reliability, observability, and maintainability of production-grade systems.
Proven experience building and maintaining scalable data infrastructure, including end-to-end ingestion, validation, and integration pipelines for complex datasets.
Proficiency in optimizing data-processing workflows and calculation performance to handle high-volume portfolio data efficiently and reliably.
Demonstrated ability to develop internal tools and dashboards that improve data quality, business intelligence, and self-service analytics capabilities.
Strong capacity to design and implement robust, reusable data schemas and workflows that adapt to evolving product needs and B2B integrations.
A collaborative mindset that prioritizes shared ownership, operational resilience, and effective cross-functional teamwork.
Hands-on experience with distributed data-processing approaches and managing computationally intensive workloads.
Experience with Financial dataset is a plus.

One in-person technical interview is required for ALL candidates

Second Coding Interview, 60m- In-person or Virtual

The opportunity to work with a diverse and talented team of industry experts, passionate about shaping the future of finance
Robust health insurance offering for you and your family

new_jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer, ML Platform
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

About The Role

We’re looking for exceptional engineers to help build the ML Platform that powers our tabular foundation model line. This is a unique chance to work at the intersection of data science, agents, UX, and real-world economic impact.

You'll work on the product end-to-end: frontend, backend, and everything in between.

What you'll work on:

Build the core platform that puts tabular foundation models into users' hands — from data upload and exploration through inference and results
Architect reliable, low-latency backend services that handle real-time model inference at scale
Work directly with the research team to turn new model capabilities into production features
Own the frontend experience for technical users (data scientists, ML engineers) who have high expectations and low tolerance for friction

You may be a good fit if you have:

3+ years building highly-available, user-facing products across the full stack, with real ownership of what shipped
Experience building data-intensive applications (dashboards, analytics tools, data exploration interfaces, or similar)
Strong JavaScript/TypeScript and Python — you're genuinely good at both, not just passable in one
Experience with React, FastAPI, and Postgres (our current stack)
Good product instincts — you think about what the user actually needs, not just what the ticket says
Comfort working close to ML systems, even if you're not training models yourself — you understand model inputs, outputs, and failure modes well enough to build reliable interfaces around them
Enthusiasm for working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where new ideas ship quickly and user impact matters most

Bonus:

Cloud infrastructure experience (GCP preferred)
Background building developer tools, data platforms, or ML-adjacent products

Life at Prior Labs

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.

Our Commitments

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SOFTWARE ENGINEER, ALERTS (STARLINK)

Starlink operates the world's largest satellite constellation, and must maintain operational control over them at all times. When things go wrong anywhere in the Starlink network, the alerting system is what our engineers and operators rely on to inform them that action is required. As a member of the Alerts team, you will be responsible for the entire alerting system, ensuring this critical operational data is created, processed, and delivered quickly, correctly, and reliably so that the right person can understand and correct the problem. You will have a direct impact on the ability of Starlink to safely scale operations to a million+ satellites and hundreds of millions of users. Your contributions will allow engineers to sleep at night, knowing that if an issue arises that requires their attention, they will be woken up. Our software engineers are responsible for the life cycle of the software they create, including development, testing, and operational support.

Responsibilities

Design, build, and operate a highly reliable alerting pipeline capable of ingesting, processing, storing and distributing alerts in real-time
Collaborate with other engineers on architecture, design, and code reviews
Maintain highest standards of excellence, never settle for the status quo
Partner closely with satellite and network teams to understand real mission needs and translate them into elegant technical solutions
Deep dive into business problems, find efficient solutions and apply first principles thinking

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a STEM discipline and 1+ years of experience building full-stack software; OR 3+ years of professional experience building full-stack software in lieu of a degree (internship experience is applicable)

Preferred Skills And Experience

Programming experience in C#, Java, or similar languages
Experience designing, building, and optimizing large-scale distributed (Kafka, HBase, HDFS) systems for transmitting, processing and querying high-volume data
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized deployments
Working knowledge of Linux, version control, testing, CI/CD, deployment, and monitoring systems

Additional Requirements

Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed
Ability to work on an "on-call" basis at night and on weekends

At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Job Description
:

The Full Stack Software Engineer is responsible for delivering high quality, maintainable, and secure software across modern backend and frontend stacks.

This role requires strong proficiency in contemporary programming languages, including Go and TypeScript/JavaScript (or equivalent technologies), with the ability to read, write, debug, and evaluate production grade code independently. Engineers in this role use AI coding assistants as a force multiplier while retaining full ownership of all resulting code. They must be able to decompose technical work, provide clear guidance to AI tools, and rigorously validate and revise generated output. Passive prompt and accept workflows are insufficient.

A core responsibility of this role is code review and quality assurance. The engineer must be comfortable performing detailed, line by line review of both self authored and generated code, identifying defects, design issues, and unnecessary complexity. They should demonstrate practical knowledge of common software design patterns and architecture principles, including interfaces, dependency injection, factory and adapter/gateway patterns, and layered system design. They apply DRY, SOLID, and reuse first principles consistently.

This role spans full stack development: backend services, data models, APIs, and modern web front ends. The engineer must maintain clear and stable contracts between client and server, ensuring well designed interactions across the stack. Work should reflect an understanding of cloud native fundamentals, including identity and access management, storage, databases, messaging, search, and containerized services. Solutions must be built against abstractions to remain portable across cloud and on premises environments. Strong data modeling skills are required, including experience with relational databases, schema creation, and migrations. The engineer must design for multi tenant security from the outset, understanding authentication versus authorization, isolation boundaries, least privilege access, and data protection considerations.

The role also requires a commitment to continuous quality through unit, integration, and automated testing; use of linters, static analysis, and CI quality gates; and validation of changes in a running environment. Engineers are expected to adhere to established project standards in structure, naming, logging, error handling, and API design, introducing new patterns only when justified and reviewed. Effective problem solving is essential. The engineer must break large requests into verifiable increments, identify the correct system layer for each change, and communicate decisions clearly to peers and reviewers. Experience working in disconnected or constrained environments is important, including development without public internet access, use of private registries and pre approved dependencies, and deployment within isolated networks. Solutions must not rely on outbound SaaS, public container pulls, or live commercial AI services at runtime.

Here's what you need
:

2+ years of experience in Systems Architecture.
Experience with Java.
Experience with Full Stack Development.
Experience with AI Assisted Software Development.
Experience with TypeScript

:

Security+
Experience working on multi service or platform engineering teams.
Familiarity with defense, government, or other high assurance environments.
Experience with multi cloud or air gapped deployments.
Background in disconnected development using private artifact registries and cross domain or multi enclave release processes.

Active TS/SCI security clearance is required.

new_jobs.description:
About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

Energy Management is a strategic bet on the next chapter of Watershed. We’re building software that helps companies turn complex energy data into better purchasing and investment decisions—reducing costs while delivering on sustainability goals.

We’re looking for a software engineer who thrives in the earliest stages of product development. As an early engineer on a small, cross-functional team, you’ll help shape both the product and how we build it. You’ll write code, speak directly with customers, learn from our energy experts, and turn what you discover into products that deliver measurable business value.

You will:

Build a product that powers Watershed’s next chapter, helping companies reduce energy costs and make better investment decisions.
Get close to the customer problem, building tools with decision-makers whose choices influence multi-million-dollar energy budgets and investments.
Shape a new product from zero to one, partnering with pilot customers to discover what delivers value and shape our path to product-market fit.
Move in fast learn → build → test cycles, shipping and refining product iterations in hours and days. You’ll be carving the marble block, not polishing a finished sculpture.
Develop AI-powered, agentic workflows that help customers understand their energy data, evaluate opportunities and make better decisions.
Apply strong engineering judgement, leveraging Watershed’s platform and expertise where they accelerate progress, and knowing when to prototype independently.
Learn the energy domain alongside in-house experts, collaborating across our New York and London team to turn that knowledge into useful products.

You’ll likely be a good fit if you:

Have 3+ years building software products, with a track record of increasing ownership and delivering work that mattered to your company and its customers.
Have helped build an early-stage product or a new product line where the customer needs and solution weren’t fully defined.
Are autonomous and proactive: you ask good questions, find direction in ambiguity, and know when to seek help.
Are comfortable working across the stack and doing the engineering needed to deliver an outcome.
Bring strong product judgement and want direct customer contact—not just a list of features to implement.
Are excited to learn the energy domain and use AI to solve real customer problems.

Useful, but not required:

Experience building customer-facing AI products or agentic workflows.
Exposure to energy-related products or businesses.
Experience with B2B software, financial modelling, or Node.js and TypeScript.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

Full Stack Engineer

Location:
Brecksville Ohio (one day a week in office)
Salary: Up to $120,000

About the role

Our client is hiring a Developer to own features and fixes from start to finish on a workforce scheduling platform for professional services firms. The product runs on ASP.NET MVC 5 (.NET Framework 4.8), a jQuery era front end and SQL Server 2019, where nearly all business logic lives in stored procedures.
The role also covers a separate ASP.NET Core (.NET 10) service that exposes scheduling and request functions as tools for external AI agents such as Copilot and Claude. It shares no code with the legacy product, calls the same stored procedures through a thin data layer, and defines its endpoints as database catalog rows rather than controllers.
This is a database first role on a small team with continuous peer review and multiple forked client deployments. You will be as comfortable reading a 400 line stored procedure in SSMS as debugging a FullCalendar plugin.

What you will do

The job is to take a ticket from the Azure DevOps board and carry it through coding, peer review, and QA handoff, across every layer the ticket touches.
Deliver features and fixes end to end. Trace a defect from the browser through the controller and provider to the stored procedure, fix it in the right layer (usually TSQL), and ship it via a repeatable migration.
Write and maintain stored procedures, views, and functions in TSQL, and check each change against the database forks.
Build and adjust dynamic UI through the template system (grids, forms, dashboards, reports) rather than hardcoding screens and know when a change needs a template edit versus a code change.
Maintain the C# layers: MVC controllers, provider classes, Hangfire background jobs, SignalR hubs, MediatR notifications, and the OWIN authentication pipeline.
Maintain the jQuery front end: the FullCalendar scheduler, ParamQuery grids, dynamic form field plugins, Select2, and DataTables reports.
Build and maintain AI agent service endpoints (End points are database driven) as catalog rows (contract, operation, endpoint) in repeatable seed migrations for each install, with matching OpenAPI contracts.
Write the stored procedures behind the API endpoints, keeping agent reachable paths off the heavy report procedures.
Maintain the AI agent service's shared code: Entra ID JWT authentication, identity resolution, problem details error handling, health checks, OpenTelemetry, and database logging.
Test the AI agent service end to end: xUnit tests, plus a PowerShell integration script for each completed feature, registered for every install so that it runs in the pipeline.
Review other developers' work as a routine part of the week by pulling tickets from Coding (Done) into Dev Testing and checking them against the repo specific checklist.
Add tests where they pay off: tSQLt for stored procedure logic, Playwright for user visible behavior, NUnit for C# utilities.
Keep the knowledge base current in Docs/knowledge base and the Azure DevOps wiki, and record architectural decisions in the decisions log.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Full Stack Engineer, Unified Ads Platform
new_jobs.description:
L'opportunité

Chez Unity, nous développons une plateforme publicitaire de calibre mondial qui fonctionne à très grande échelle partout dans le monde. L’équipe Ads conçoit les systèmes qui mettent en relation les annonceur(euse)s, les créateur(rice)s et les joueur(euse)s, favorisant ainsi la performance, la fiabilité et la croissance de notre écosystème.

À titre de développeur(euse) full-stack principal(e) au sein de l’équipe Unified Ads Platform, vous serez responsable de la couche de services où résident les entités des annonceur(euse)s et des éditeur(rice)s : campagnes et plafonds budgétaires, applications et blocs d’annonces, ensembles de créations et Pipeline de modération connexe, devise de l’Offerwall, tests A/B et intégration de LevelPlay. Ces données sont utilisées par l’ensemble de notre infrastructure publicitaire, et nos API constituent la source de référence pour la diffusion, la facturation et la production de rapports.

Ce poste ne consiste pas simplement à créer une API avant de passer au prochain projet. Les données que vous modélisez sont utilisées par des systèmes dont vous n’êtes pas responsable, dans des processus où une valeur erronée peut entraîner des pertes financières. Vous concevrez des contrats qui demeurent stables à mesure que le produit évolue, veillerez à la cohérence des états entre les différents services et assumerez la responsabilité de l’exactitude et de la disponibilité de l’ensemble de ces éléments en production.

Ce poste convient parfaitement à une personne qui maîtrise autant le côté serveur que le côté client, qui accorde une grande importance aux contrats de données et à l’exactitude, et qui souhaite assumer pleinement la responsabilité de systèmes dont dépendent d’autres équipes de développement.

Ce que vous allez faire

Concevoir, développer et exploiter des services dans notre plateforme TypeScript (NestJS) pour un vaste modèle de domaine, tout en étant responsable des API et des contrats de données dont dépendent les systèmes publicitaires en aval.
Modéliser les données d’entité en tenant compte de l’évolutivité et des changements, notamment par la conception de schémas relationnels, les migrations et l’évolution des schémas des tables utilisées pour la diffusion, la facturation et la production de rapports.
Concevoir et développer des intégrations événementielles avec Kafka et Google Cloud Pub/Sub, au moyen de modèles tels que la boîte d’envoi transactionnelle et les consommateurs idempotents, afin de maintenir la cohérence entre les différents services.
Créer les interfaces destinées aux utilisateur(rice)s dans React et TypeScript, en transformant des données complexes sur les entités et la performance en processus auxquels les éditeur(rice)s et les annonceur(euse)s peuvent se fier.
Exploiter les solutions que vous développez sur Kubernetes, où le service déclare sa propre infrastructure infonuagique avec son code, et assumer pleinement la responsabilité de ses objectifs de niveau de service.
Renforcer l’observabilité et la qualité de la plateforme au moyen du traçage distribué, des mesures et des cadres de test.
Établir les normes de développement du service et veiller à leur respect lors des revues de conception et de code, tout en accompagnant les développeur(euse)s.

Ce que nous recherchons

Au moins six ans d’expérience en développement et en exploitation de logiciels en production, avec une expertise approfondie des services côté serveur et des technologies modernes côté client.
Une maîtrise avancée de TypeScript et une expérience avec un cadre modulaire structuré pour Node côté serveur, comme NestJS, ou avec une architecture comparable reposant sur l’injection de dépendances et les modules.
De solides compétences en modélisation de données et en SQL, notamment en conception de schémas, en migrations et en optimisation de la performance à grande échelle, ainsi qu’un bon jugement en matière de gestion des versions d’API. Vous avez déjà dû modifier de façon sécuritaire des données utilisées par d’autres équipes.
Une expérience des systèmes événementiels, comme Kafka, Pub/Sub ou un outil comparable. Vous comprenez les garanties de livraison, l’ordre des événements, l’idempotence et les conséquences d’une divergence entre deux systèmes.
Une maîtrise avancée de React ainsi qu’un excellent jugement en matière de conception de composants, de gestion des états et de performance des interfaces qui traitent un volume important de données.
Une expérience de l’exploitation infonuagique native, notamment des services conteneurisés sur Kubernetes, et une capacité à assumer la responsabilité d’un système en production, y compris son déploiement, sa mise à l’échelle, sa surveillance, l’intervention en cas d’incident et les périodes de disponibilité sur appel.
Un fort sens des responsabilités, axé sur l’exactitude, l’observabilité et la maintenabilité à long terme, soutenu par une discipline rigoureuse en matière de tests, de revues et d’accessibilité.

Vous avez peut-être également (facultatif)

Expérience avec Go.
Expérience dans les systèmes publicitaires, d’attribution, de facturation ou de monétisation.
Expérience de l’infrastructure en tant que code, notamment la gestion des ressources native à Kubernetes, Terraform ou les maillages de services.
Connaissance d’OpenTelemetry et du traçage distribué en production.
Expérience des systèmes de conception ou des cadres d’interface utilisateur pilotés par la configuration.
Expérience de l’harmonisation technique entre les équipes ou d’initiatives de qualité menées par des communautés de pratique.

The opportunity

At Unity, we're building a world-class advertising platform that operates at a massive global scale. The Ads team powers the systems that connect advertisers with creators and players, driving performance, reliability, and growth across our ecosystem.

As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer on the Unified Ads Platform team, you'll own the service layer where advertiser and publisher entities live. Campaigns and budget caps, applications and ad units, creative packs and the moderation pipeline behind them, offerwall currency, A/B tests, LevelPlay integration. These are the records the rest of the ads estate reads from, and our APIs are the source of truth for them across serving, billing, and reporting.

This role goes beyond building an API and moving on. The data you model is consumed by systems you don't own, in paths where a wrong value costs money. You'll design contracts that stay stable as the product changes, keep state consistent across service boundaries, and own the correctness and availability of all of it in production.

This role is ideal for someone strong on both sides of the stack who thinks in terms of data contracts and correctness, and who wants real ownership of systems other engineering teams depend on.

What You'll Be Doing

Design, build, and operate services in our TypeScript platform (NestJS) across a large domain model, owning the APIs and data contracts that downstream ads systems depend on
Model entity data for scale and change — relational schema design, migrations, and schema evolution against tables that serving, billing, and reporting all read from
Design and build event-driven integrations with Kafka and Google Cloud Pub/Sub, using patterns such as transactional outbox and idempotent consumers to maintain consistency across service boundaries.
Deliver the user-facing surfaces on top of the platform in React and TypeScript, turning dense entity and performance data into workflows publishers and advertisers can trust
Operate what you build on Kubernetes, where the service declares its own cloud infrastructure alongside its code, and take real ownership of its SLOs
Drive observability and quality across the platform — distributed tracing, metrics, and testing frameworks
Set the standards for how the service is built and hold the line on them in design and code review, mentoring engineers as you go

What We're Looking For

6+ years building and operating production software, with real depth on both backend services and modern frontend
Advanced TypeScript, and experience with an opinionated, modular Node backend framework — NestJS, or comparable dependency-injection and module architectures
Strong data modelling and SQL — schema design, migrations, and performance at scale, alongside the API versioning judgment that goes with it. You've had to change something other teams read from, safely
Event-driven systems — Kafka, Pub/Sub, or similar. You understand delivery semantics, ordering, and idempotency, and what happens when two systems disagree
Advanced React, with strong judgment around component design, state management, and performance in data-intensive interfaces
Cloud-native operation — containerized services on Kubernetes, and comfort owning the system in production, including deployment, scaling, monitoring, incident response, and on-call
Strong ownership mindset — focused on correctness, observability, and long-term maintainability, backed by real engineering discipline in testing, review, and accessibility

You might also have

Experience with Go
Background in ads, attribution, billing, or monetization systems
Infrastructure-as-code experience — Kubernetes-native resource management, Terraform, or service mesh
Familiarity with OpenTelemetry and distributed tracing in production
Experience with design systems or configuration-driven UI frameworks
Exposure to cross-team technical alignment or guild-style quality initiatives

En plus du salaire de base, ce poste peut donner droit à des attributions d’actions et à une participation à nos programmes d’incitation de l’entreprise, comme des primes annuelles discrétionnaires ou des commissions de vente. Le montant final de l’offre dépendra de plusieurs facteurs, notamment l’emplacement géographique ainsi que l’expérience pertinente, le parcours professionnel et les compétences du/de la candidat(e).

This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). Avantages

Chez Unity, nous voulons que nos membres d’équipe s’épanouissent. Nous offrons un large éventail d’avantages conçus pour soutenir le bien-être et l’équilibre travail-vie personnelle.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineer, Vercel Agent
new_jobs.description:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About The Role:

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join the Vercel Agent team. Our mission is simple: deploying on Vercel should feel like adding a seasoned infrastructure engineer to your team. The Vercel Agent investigates incidents before you see them, fixes failing builds, reviews code with deep production context, and answers questions about your running app with the authority of someone who has read the logs.

Today, this work spans multiple shipped products: automated code review on every PR, AI -driven investigation of production anomalies, an intelligent support agent that resolves the majority of customer issues without human intervention, and conversational code generation . We’re now unifying these into a single agent that appears pervasively across surfaces (like the Vercel dashboard, Vercel CLI, Slack, and many more), and is capable of multi-step reasoning, code execution in sandboxed environments, and taking real actions on your behalf.

Two things we’re most excited about: self-driving infrastructure
, where 90% of what requires manual DevOps today gets handled automatically by the platform ; and framework-defined agents
, where the agent is customized to each customer’s application, injecting the right skills when they’re needed rather than dumping generic best practices.

This is a small team with an outsized mandate. You’ll work directly with leadership and across product, design , and infrastructure teams to define what self-driving infrastructure looks like — then build it.

If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday, even if the role is listed as remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

What You Will Do:

Design and build agentic systems that autonomously investigate, diagnose, and remediate production issues — from 500 errors and build failures to performance regressions and security anomalies.
Architect multi-step agent workflows that coordinate across tools, APIs, and sandboxed code execution environments, with durable state that survives crashes and timeouts.
Build the skills and tool integrations that give the agent deep knowledge of the Vercel platform, such as deployments, functions, logs, metrics, DNS, and the full lifecycle of a web application.
Ship polished, user-facing experiences across multiple surfaces (Slack, dashboard, CLI) without waiting for a designer to hand you a mockup. This team values engineers with strong product and UI instincts.
Develop the infrastructure for dynamic skill injection, so the agent acquires new capabilities at runtime rather than through redeployment, routing the right logic to the right context at the right time.
Collaborate with other engineers on prompt engineering, model evaluation, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines that ground the agent in accurate, up-to-date knowledge.

About You:

7+ years of full-time software engineering experience, with strong TypeScript proficiency. Engineers with deep Python experience who are excited to work in TypeScript are also a great fit.
A track record of openness and adaptability: you’ve shifted into new technologies, new domains, or new roles and thrived. This space is changing faster than anyone can claim expertise; we want people who learn and adapt, not people who play expert.
Strong product and UI sensibility. You care about the details of how an AI interaction feels to a user, and you can build great experiences without waiting for a designer.
Full-stack capability with an understanding of infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, and how large-scale web applications operate.
Experience building or contributing to frameworks, platforms, or reusable abstractions, not just feature work. You know when to build a primitive versus ship a one-off.
Demonstrated ability to ship independently, influence architecture, and set direction on a small, high-impact team.
Excellent communication skills, with an ability to translate technical detail into actionable insight for both engineering and partner teams.

Bonus if you:

Have experience building agentic systems, AI tooling, or automation frameworks, and especially agents in production. You understand the difference between a demo and a system that works reliably at scale.
Are familiar with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, etc.), prompt engineering, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
Have worked with Vercel, Next.js, or the modern web deployment ecosystem.
Have experience with sandboxed execution environments, container orchestration, or secure multi-tenant systems.

Compensation & Benefits:

Competitive compensation package, including equity.
Inclusive Healthcare Package.
Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
Flexible Time Off.
We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $232,000 - $348,000 (Staff level IC and above). Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, level/experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

Equal Opportunity: Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

Note:
Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. Therefore, in order to be considered for this position, you must have the ability to work in the United States without a need for current or future visa sponsorship.

Must be located near or within the Raleigh-Durham area.

Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking a hands-on Software Engineer IV to drive end-to-end solution delivery for major retail platforms.

In this role, you will own hands-on implementation (feature development, technical design, code reviews), engagement leadership (client-facing technical lead, trade-off decisions, mentoring), and operational ownership (delivery sign-off, post-release support) of high-impact solutions, translating business requirements into working software you help build. You will drive Dual-Track Agile processes, contributing to the Discovery Track through rapid prototyping and feasibility validation, and leading the Delivery Track to ensure quality, traceability, and measurable outcomes.

The ideal candidate is a senior software engineer who codes daily, prototypes proactively, and integrates AI/agent workflows across the software lifecycle—from analysis and design to testing, documentation, and code generation—while bringing the technical leadership to drive client engagements forward. You will mentor teams, make critical technical trade-offs, and take full accountability for delivery sign-off and post-release support.

This role requires strong retail platform domain knowledge (POS systems, store operations), cloud-native development experience, and fluency with generative and agentic AI tools to accelerate delivery while preserving code quality and architectural integrity. You will be a key driver of engineering excellence, ensuring solutions are both innovative and operationally robust.

Key Responsibilities

Instrument and leverage AI/agentic workflows in your daily development to accelerate design, prototyping, code generation, test-case creation, specification drafting, and automated validation across the software lifecycle.
Apply AI-assisted development practices in your own work, model best practices for the team, and ensure ethical compliance and responsible integration of generative AI tools.
Own end-to-end solution delivery across Discovery and Delivery Tracks, personally building validated prototypes, contributing to formal designs, decomposing work into deliverables, and shipping accepted technical implementations.
Drive the Discovery Track under Dual-Track Agile by writing working prototypes and demoing solutions to validate feasibility and align stakeholders before full implementation.
Translate discovery outcomes into delivery backlog items and partner with implementation teams to ensure design intent, code quality standards, and non-functional requirements are preserved throughout delivery.
Contribute to technical design across products and integrations: produce ADRs, interface contracts, data models, sequencing diagrams, migration/rollback plans, and traceability matrices, partnering with architects on broader governance.
Serve as the primary technical lead in client engagements: facilitate workshops, present technical solutions, make trade-off decisions, drive approvals, and act as a subject-matter expert for assigned platform areas.
Personally implement critical components and complex features in modern retail platform stacks, set the bar for code quality through your own work, and review and approve deliverables from implementation teams.
Apply and reinforce engineering standards, reusable integration patterns, and non-functional requirements (security, scalability, observability) across client solutions.
Mentor and upskill engineers on AI-assisted development, Dual-Track workflows, specification-driven design, and platform best practices, primarily through pair programming, code reviews, and example-driven leadership.
Contribute to platform and product strategy, identifying reusable assets, API-first designs, and technical gaps requiring investment.
Own risk analysis and mitigation for technical decisions, including backward compatibility, data integrity, and compliance constraints.

Must-Have Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, and 8+ years’ experience.
Applying and utilizing AI-assisted tools and workflows (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) for design, coding, test generation, and documentation.
8+ years of professional software development experience with current, daily hands-on coding and prototyping in modern technology stacks.
8+ years building cloud-native, microservices, or event-driven systems, with experience in Azure or equivalent cloud platforms.
Strong proficiency in technology stacks such as Java/Spring Boot, TypeScript, React/Vue.
Proven experience owning end-to-end solution delivery, including design, implementation, and post-release operational accountability for medium-to-large projects.
Track record of building production code, prototypes, and reference implementations to validate solution feasibility.
Strong experience with REST/OpenAPI, messaging platforms, and relational/non-relational databases (SQL/NoSQL).
Hands-on proficiency with CI/CD, containerization, Docker, Kubernetes, deployment tooling, automated testing, and AI/agentic workflows to accelerate the software lifecycle.
Practical experience with generative AI and AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) with measurable impact on delivery.
Excellent stakeholder communication skills, able to facilitate workshops, present technical solutions, and collaborate across business and engineering teams.
Proven leadership in mentoring engineers, conducting thorough code reviews, and championing engineering best practices across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Strong retail platform domain knowledge (POS systems, store operations) is highly desirable.
Certifications such as Azure Developer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect, or equivalent cloud credentials.
Strong understanding of advanced security best practices and compliance requirements in enterprise systems.
Experience leading Dual-Track Agile processes, managing both Discovery and Delivery Tracks, and translating discovery outcomes into actionable backlog items.
Experience contributing to platform strategy, reusable assets, and API-first designs.
Expertise in formal or machine-readable specifications (OpenAPI, UML+OCL, TLA+, or equivalent) to guide implementation and enable automated validation.

About Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions

Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is a dynamic billion-dollar global company based in Research Triangle Park, NC, providing retail store solutions to your favorite brands. Have you ever been in a hurry and made use of the self-checkout at Lowe's Foods, earned fuel rewards at Kroger, or just paid for purchases at retailers such as Walmart, Michaels, Carrefour, The Gap, Calvin Klein, Boots, Cencosud, BJ's, or Costco? new_jobs.description:
At AMEWAS, we don’t just support defense-we shape it. For over 40 years, we’ve been a trusted partner of the Department of Defense (DoD) by providing cutting-edge engineering, testing, and evaluation for U.S. Navy weapons systems.

Our people are the heart of our mission. Across our headquarters in California, Maryland, and offices in Orlando, FL, and San Diego, CA, you'll find a diverse and driven team committed to making a real impact for our Nation’s Warfighters.

If you're ready to grow your skills, be challenged by meaningful work, and contribute to something bigger…this is where you belong.

Come do work that matters. Join AMEWAS.

The Position

AMEWAS is seeking a highly motivated and talented Software Developer (DAPS)-Journeyman to support Advanced Aircraft Research, Development, Test & Evaluation. The salary range of this position is $115,800.00 - $175,000.00 and is commensurate with experience. This position is not eligible for remote work; on-site support is required.

About the location:

Patuxent River, MD, located in the California-Lexington Park area, is Maryland’s #1 City Hiring the Most High-Tech Workers. To learn more about the surrounding area, please visit: www.visitstmarysmd.com

Work Arrangement

Remote or hybrid work arrangements are subject to business, contract, customer, and/or government requirements and may be modified or discontinued as needed. The Company reserves the right to require an employee to report to a designated Company or customer worksite when business or contractual requirements change.

Position Background

The Data Acquisition and Processing (DAPS) team is a government run team that supports data collection efforts during electromagnetic pulse (EMP), Lightning, and Radio Frequency (RF) susceptibility testing at Naval Air Station Patuxent River Maryland. As a Software Developer on the DAPS team will support the development, validation, installation and integration proof-of-concept acquisition software to interface with both new and legacy Data Acquisition and Processing System (DAPS) hardware commercial off the shelf (COTS) products and databases at the Electromagnetic Pulse (EMP) facility.

A typical day as a Software Developer (DAPS)-Journeyman may include:

Designs a Windows application that will serve as the new DAPS software
Utilizes an Agile implementation process
Employs Agile methods using fixed-length Sprints encompassing requirements, design, development, testing and deployment
Delivers a finished and tested product at the end of each Sprint
Utilizes Agile method such as SCRUM or DoD agile standard
Utilizes Python, Django, VS Code (or other IDEs), Windows, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, GitLab, MySQL (or other DBs)
Develops, designs, documents, and delivers a high-level design of the overall system architecture for a new Data Acquisition and Processing System (DAPS) using Agile implementation processes
Attends daily internal discussions, performs development work, participates in Sprint Review/Sprint Retrospective meetings, and completes a high-level design element for the overall system at the end of each sprint
Conducts a preliminary design review and the systems requirements review of the high-level design
Creates the System Architecture documentation
Works with the team to develop all other documentation for this project
Supports the software developer team in creating DAPS software that will:
Communicate/Import the legacy DAPS Microsoft Access Structured Query Language (SQL) relational database
Interact/Interface with the existing EG&G ODS-1500 and ODS-2200 Optical Data Link transceivers used at NAWCAD EMP facility
Interface for recording, playback, presentation, and post execution analysis
Incorporate a new graphic user interface (GUI) to control software functions
Communicates with Windows based systems (oscilloscopes, network analyzers, computers, etc.)
Conforms with approved design

Must-haves

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Engineering. Degrees in Information Technology, Mathematics, Physics, or Aerospace, Computer, Software Systems, Electrical, Electronic, Mechanical Engineering may qualify
3 years of experience working as a Software Developer using Django, VS Code (or other IDEs), Windows, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, GitLab, MySQL (or other DBs)
Professional experience with Python
Professional experience with DevOps and Continuous Integration
Experience with complex application architectures (separation of application roles and using/designing APIs to control/retrieve data from other applications)
Experience designing GUIs (OS or web applications)
Experience analyzing existing and designing new database schemas
Knowledge of standard programming algorithms, design patterns, and object-oriented software design
Experience analyzing legacy software as part of software modernization efforts
Experience using Agile development and DevOps methodologies
The ability to collaborate with customers (including engineers and technicians) to design, develop and deploy solutions
Minimum clearance required to apply (candidates who do not currently hold the required clearance will not be considered): N/A
Current clearance required upon onboarding: DoD Secret Clearance
Additional Accesses: The ability to obtain and maintain the DoD security clearance eligibility and/or additional security access requirements necessary to perform the duties of the position, as required by the contract. U.S. Citizenship is required for all clearances.

Desired Skills

Experience with Django
Experience with C++, JavaScript, or HTML
Experience using oscilloscopes and other RF measurement equipment
Experience developing software to collect data from measurement equipment
Experience using containers as part of DevOps
Experience supporting Special Access Program (SAP) efforts

Security Clearance Requirement Disclaimer:
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain all security clearances, interim security determinations, and/or other access authorizations required by the applicable contract(s). Candidates who are unable to obtain the required interim clearance or access authorization within the timeframe necessary to meet business and contract requirements may no longer be considered for employment.

Employment Eligibility and Sponsorship Disclaimer:
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. AMEWAS is unable to provide employment-based visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future.

Skills Crucial To Success At AMEWAS

Candidates must demonstrate a customer-focused mindset, professionalism, and discretion, while working collaboratively with management and teams to meet objectives. Candidates should be hard-working individuals with strong attention to detail and the ability to foster a positive, team-oriented culture.

Physical Environment And Working Conditions

The physical environment for this position requires the employee to work in an office, sitting in a cubicle or at a desk, looking at a computer for most of the workday. Work is physically comfortable. The employee has discretion about sitting, walking, standing, etc.

The employee may be required to travel short distances to offices/conference rooms and buildings on site or near the work site. On rare occasions, overnight travel may be required.

Refer a Friend

We’re always on the lookout for top talent. If you know someone who would be a great fit for this role, please share our post with them!

Here’s an added perk: If you’re a current AMEWAS employee and your referral is hired, you could earn a referral bonus!

Our Excellent Benefits And Perks

Staying connected to our core values sets us apart from our competition! AMEWAS recognizes and rewards performance, dedication, and creativity. We are committed to investing in our employees and their future by providing them with competitive compensation, creative work teams, and the opportunity to grow in their career. We also provide a robust benefits package, including:

new_jobs.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About The IT Product Team

The IT Product Engineering team is critical to unifying Rippling's workforce management system, bridging the gap between HR and traditional IT administration. Our mission is to build software that enables businesses to manage employee devices, applications, and access security automatically, leveraging Rippling's single source of employee truth (the HRIS). We automate the complexity of IT management from the moment a new employee is hired to the moment they offboard.

What We Build

We build the mission-critical software that simplifies IT for organizations, turning complex, manual processes into simple, one-click solutions. Our core product domains include:

Device Management (MDM): Developing systems to securely enroll, configure, manage, and inventory corporate devices (macOS, Windows, iOS, etc.), including policy enforcement and remote wipe capabilities.
App Management & Identity: Creating the centralized platform for provisioning and de-provisioning employee access to hundreds of third-party SaaS applications, ensuring instant security and compliance through integrated identity and access management (IAM).
Inventory & Asset Management: Building the core financial and logistical systems to track physical assets, manage software licenses, and automate IT procurement from device ordering to deployment.
Security & Compliance: Developing the mechanisms for setting, managing, and enforcing security policies across all devices and applications, ensuring employee and corporate data remain protected.

What You Will Do

Design, implement, and test reliable backend services and APIs that power core product features and business logic at scale.
Work across key technical domains, including API design, data modeling, event modeling, and optimizing service performance.
Own the development lifecycle for defined features, from implementation and testing to deployment, monitoring, and support in a production environment.
Effectively integrate into cross-functional teams, contribute to technical discovery, and rapidly learn from code and system feedback.

What You Will Need

2+ years of professional experience as a backend engineer, preferably with Python, Go, or a similar production language, and strong experience with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL).
Care about business impact, balancing technical craft with speed and the bottom line to deliver value quickly.
Ability to thrive in fast-paced, dynamic environments, demonstrating resilience and agility in the face of changing product needs.
Excellent skills in communicating complex technical ideas with clarity to enable effective collaboration with peers and stakeholders.

Additional Information

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com

For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.
